description: This file defines the LoggerPatternParser class used to parse logging pattern strings and create a chain of LoggerPatternConverter objects for log message formatting. It includes methods for parsing pattern syntax, extracting options, and finalizing specific pattern converters.

classes.name: LoggerPatternParser
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing pattern strings used in log formatting and constructing a linked list of pattern converter objects.

methods.name: LoggerPatternParser
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the parser with a pattern string.

methods.name: addToList
methods.description: Adds a LoggerPatternConverter object to the internal linked list.

methods.name: extractOption
methods.description: Extracts an option enclosed in braces '{}' from the pattern string.

methods.name: extractPrecisionOption
methods.description: Extracts a numeric precision option from the pattern string, used for formatting.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main parsing method that processes the pattern string and constructs a chain of pattern converters.

methods.name: finalizeConverter
methods.description: Creates specific pattern converter objects based on pattern characters and links them into the chain.

methods.name: addConverter
methods.description: Adds a converter to the chain and resets the parser state to literal.
